finding.deadline: Transition-planning documentation by 1 July 2030; progress demonstration after 22 September 2028
finding.summary: HKMA issued GS-2 V.1 on 22 September 2026 as a non-statutory SPM guidance note applicable to all authorized institutions. It sets supervisory expectations for governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets, stakeholder engagement, scenario analysis and communication. AIs should have transition-planning documentation in place by 1 July 2030, take active implementation steps beforehand, and be prepared to demonstrate progress 24 months after issuance.
finding.title: GS-2 Transition Planning — corrected finding

reason: The delivered finding preserved the circular metadata but did not retrieve and analyse the directly related, machine-readable GS-2 V.1 module. The omitted primary source establishes classification, all-AI application, supervisory expectations and implementation dates that materially change the finding.
